resale_co.name: Certificate of Resale (online Certificate of Compliance application)
resale_co.valid_for: 180 days from the date of issuance
requirements: A current survey must be submitted with the application
The owner certifies the home and all other structures on the lot meet Township zoning
No rubbish, debris or bulk garbage may be left on the property before the new occupancy
List any deck, fence, shed, pool, garage or finished basement on the application

Smoke alarms by year built: before 1984 on all levels and outside each sleeping area (battery alarms OK); 1984 to 1990 also interconnected; after 1990 on all levels and in each bedroom, interconnected, with battery backup
Carbon monoxide alarms (UL 2034 listed) near each sleeping area
No door locks that need a key to get out
House numbers at least 3 inches high, contrasting color, readable from the curb
Fire extinguisher: at least 5 lb ABC dry chemical in the kitchen area (listed on the resale application)
A separate Smoke Detector Inspection application and fee are also required for residential properties

fees.label: Reinspection after a failed inspection
fees.quote: NOTE: A failed inspection will require a reinspection with a $25.00 additional fee.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the Township's online Certificate of Resale (Certificate of Compliance) application and pay online, attaching a current survey. Then call the Construction Department at 732-428-8401 to schedule the inspection. Residential sellers must also file the separate online Smoke Detector Inspection form.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Official / Building Subcode Official / Zoning Officer

evidence.quote: Residential, industrial or commercial properties must secure a Certificate of Resale before sale of the property.
Clark Township's Certificate of Resale can be completed, and fees paid online. Residential properties must also complete a Smoke Detector Inspection form , fees are also payable online.
A Certificate of Resale is good for 180 days from the date of issuance.
Please be advised that you must call the Construction Department at 732-428-8401 to schedule an inspection.
Commercial Resale- $500 Commercial Change of Use - $300 Residential Resale - $125
All requests for a Certificate of Compliance Application require a current survey.
I attest to the fact that no rubbish/debris/bulk garbage will be left on this property prior to new occupancy.
Minimum 51b. ABC Dry Chemical, Kitchen Area.
Art Figueiredo - Construction Official/Building Subcode Official/Zoning Officer
Art Figueiredo Construction/Building Subcode Official / Inspector Email Art Figueiredo
Construction Email the Construction Department Phone: 732-428-8401

resale_co.notes: Art Figueiredo's email (afigueiredo@ourclark.com) and the department email (const@ourclark.com) are mailto links on the Residential Housing page. The extinguisher size on the online form reads "Minimum 51b.", which looks like a typo for 5 lb. The application also says owners of properties built before 1978 must submit a Lead Safe Certification "(Not Required for Certificate of Continued Occupancy)"; the state lead-safe law applies to rentals, so confirm whether it applies to a sale. Landlords must register rental units (Landlord/Rental Unit Registration form); that is a rental requirement, not a resale requirement. Commercial resale is $500 and commercial change of use $300.

requirements: Smoke alarms by year built: before 1984 on all levels and outside each sleeping area (battery alarms OK); 1984 to 1990 interconnected; after 1990 on all levels and in each bedroom, interconnected, with battery backup
Carbon monoxide alarms listed to UL 2034 in the immediate vicinity of each sleeping area (battery alarms OK)
Front door locks that need a key to exit must be replaced before the inspection
House numbers at least 3 inches high, contrasting, readable from the curb
A Certificate of Resale must also be filed

authorities.name: Clark Township Fire Prevention (Code Enforcement Office), Smoke and CO Inspection

fees.label: Reinspection after a failed inspection
fees.quote: NOTE: A failed inspection will require a reinspection with a $25.00 additional fee.

authorities.how_to_apply: Complete the Township's online Smoke and CO Inspection form and pay online (the form says a Certificate of Resale must also be filed). After the alarms meet the requirements, call the Code Enforcement Office at 732-381-1158 for an appointment. The same form also tells applicants to call the Construction Department at 732-428-8401 to schedule an inspection.

evidence.quote: PLEASE NOTE: YOU MUST ALSO FILE A CERTIFICATE OF RESALE.
After you have verified that you have fulfilled the requirements please call the Code Enforcement Office at 732-381-1158 for an appointment.
If an Inspection fails for the first time for any reason, an additional check or money order for $25.00 will be required at time of second Inspection.
Please be advised that you must call the Construction Department at 732-428-8401 to schedule an inspection.
LEAID: 2002-001 Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official Frank J Cerasa Phone (732) 904-7251 Addr: 252 Broadway Clark NJ 07066 Phone (732) 381-1158 ... Clark Twp Fire Prev

fire_cert.notes: The smoke/CO inspection is applied for on the Township's online form linked from the Construction Department's Residential Housing page. The state directory lists the fire official as Frank J Cerasa (Clark Twp Fire Prev, 252 Broadway) with smoke detector compliance phone (732) 381-1158, which matches the Code Enforcement Office number on the form. The directory's only email for him is a personal-style comcast.net address, so no email is listed here; the directory's (732) 904-7251 line is also its emergency number. The online smoke form has a single $50 per unit fee with no lead-time tiers, and it does not list a fire extinguisher, although the Certificate of Resale form still does.

other_items.label: Current survey
other_items.detail: All Certificate of Resale (Certificate of Compliance) applications require a current survey.

other_items.label: No debris at new occupancy
other_items.detail: The owner attests no rubbish, debris or bulk garbage will be left on the property before the new occupancy, or the certificate can be retracted and a summons issued.

open_questions: Does the Fire Prevention (Code Enforcement) office or the Construction Department schedule the smoke inspection? The online form names both.
Is a fire extinguisher still checked on resale (the resale form lists one; the smoke form does not)?
